tooltip.computronics.pocket_terminal.des: Compact handheld wireless terminal & pager with real-time HUD display.
Receives wireless drawing & text streaming commands via OpenComputers.
Right-click toggles power. Recharges on Inductive Charger Pad.
tooltip.computronics.entity_detector.des: High-precision directional entity and player scanner with configurable cone.
tooltip.computronics.card_fx.desc: Emits programmable particle effects around machine.
tooltip.computronics.mini_lamp.desc: Right-click on Control Panel to mount a miniature RGB LED.
tooltip.computronics.mini_button.desc: Right-click on Control Panel to mount a tactile push button.
tooltip.computronics.upgrade.speech: Equips robots and drones with a voice synthesizer.
tooltip.computronics.network_card_3.desc: Tier 3 Ethernet Controller with 64 open ports.
Supports 64 KB Jumbo Frames for high-throughput networks.
tooltip.computronics.packet_sniffer.desc: Promiscuous TAP mode for passive traffic analysis.
Monitors PPS, bandwidth, and filters network frames.
tooltip.computronics.card_boom.desc: Detonates computer case on demand. Handle with caution!
tooltip.computronics.rf_jammer_card.desc: Mobile radio frequency jammer for computers, tablets, and robots.
Disrupts and scrambles wireless communications in a dynamic radius.
tooltip.computronics.upgrade.chat: Allows robots and drones to speak in chat and whisper to players.
tooltip.computronics.upgrade.radar: Equips robots and drones with a 3D entity radar.
tooltip.computronics.upgrade.camera: Equips robots and drones with optical distance and raycast scanning.
tooltip.computronics.upgrade.winch: Equips drones with a deployable winch cable and grabber hook.
